action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated with weak seasonality and unstable model ranking (Kendall tau 0.251). The full-pool weighted combination (w1, near-uniform concentration 0.083) leverages the diversity of 19 models, which is critical when no single model dominates and errors are highly correlated within groups. The leader is a seeded baseline with an 'indistinguishable' margin over the runner-up, and with only 3 validation windows, further weight-fitting would chase noise rather than signal. The full-pool strategies (mean, dba, weighted) all outperform subset strategies here, confirming that breadth of the pool is the key robustness mechanism for this non-stationary, trend-heavy series.
